name: Grayhaven
subtitle: Town, coast and countryside
description: Explore the streets, quays, farmsteads, orchards and fields of Grayhaven. Building functions, district names and stories are fictional interpretations of the map artwork.
credit: Fantasy map generated from a user-supplied Google Maps screenshot and styled with the Dragonsgate map as a visual reference. Original map data © Google. Buildings and stories are fictional.
